description: Eight channels of random voltage, one per trigger input, each with its own division, probability, quantising and looping

params.text: Sets the output level of that channel before any quantising
Counts incoming triggers on that channel and lets the output change only every 1 to 8 of them
Sets the chance from 0% to 100% that a trigger on that channel produces a new value
Picks the algorithm generating that channel's random values: Standard, Rosc, Gamma, Expo, Weibull, Low-High, FBM or Perlin
Adds a fixed 0-10V to that channel's output
Quantises that channel's output to a musical scale, with the leftmost position leaving it unquantised
Slews that channel's output from one value to the next, applied after quantising
Sets how many steps long that channel's loop is, from 1 to 32
A short press cycles that channel's looping between off, a locked loop, and a loop that mutates a step now and then; a long press opens that row's menu page, and a very long press resets the channel

inputs.text: A rising edge draws a new value on that channel, subject to its divider and its probability

outputs.text: That channel's random voltage, after gain, offset, quantising and slew

notes: each channel has one knob, and which of its eight settings that knob edits depends on the page the module is showing. The right-click menu reaches the eight pages by name.
hold a channel button for about a second and let go to open that button's page; a click on any button then returns to the performance panel.
menu: Load preset — loads the whole state from one of eight slots, each listed as used or unused
Save preset — writes the whole state into one of eight slots, each listed as used or unused
Performance Mode — leaves the menu pages and puts the eight knobs back to the channel gain setting
Preset — shows the preset page, where the eight channel buttons load and save the eight preset slots
Divider — puts the eight channel knobs on the divider setting
Probability — puts the eight channel knobs on the probability setting
Style — puts the eight channel knobs on the random style setting
Offset — puts the eight channel knobs on the offset setting
Scale — puts the eight channel knobs on the quantiser scale setting
Slide — puts the eight channel knobs on the slide setting
Steps — puts the eight channel knobs on the loop length setting
Initialize channel 1 — on the right-click menu of that channel's button, puts every setting of that channel back to its default
